translations.web: and I will shake all nations. The precious things of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: I will shake all the nations, and they will come with all their treasures, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: and I will shake all nations; and the precious things of all nations shall come; and I will fill this house with glory, saith Jehovah of hosts.
